decision: Not adopted. Independent resampling reduces the known critical-cell discrepancy but does not recover game values. Six raw fitted policies are provably worse than the pure fallback; the existing heuristic gate rejects them in this sample. General gate safety remains unproved, and evaluation adds substantial work.
scope: Sixteen archived pinned-team search trees, including the known failing seed and controls from two tactical families. Both extraction rules evaluate immutable trees, and complete search snapshots match before and after evaluation. MostVisited is a separate frozen-policy control, not the original online UCB process. SampleVisits independently draws each side from its node visit counts; missing continuations use the existing rollout. Means and standard errors describe sampled fixed-policy returns, not game-value certificates. Policies fitted to those means are separately assessed with archived full-state minimax matrices and optimal subsequent play. Identical evaluation seeds do not imply identical trajectories across policies. This adds evaluation work and is not a matched-time strength experiment, a blind information-set certificate, or an adopted bot change.
